On 979 frozen support questions, ASM-CM + Bridge 8.1 delivered 93.6% Recall@5 and a 66.5% diagnostic answer score while sending about 1.09K input tokens per question to the reader.

Read the measured results →

What the system protects

22 failure classes.
One threat model.

The matrix organizes the documented risks across feedback, retrieval, authorization, delivery and lifecycle. It is a threat taxonomy—not a fabricated 22-test denominator.

Measured evidence: 18/18 deterministic controls passed, and 45/45 unsafe deliveries were contained across nine bounded language scenarios. Reader quality remains a separate metric.

01 Protocol mapped

Feedback integrity

Corrections improve retrieval without silently becoming source truth.

  • Incorrect feedback and revocationCovered
  • Malicious feedbackCovered
  • Stale corrections and temporal supersessionCovered
  • Accumulated and contradictory feedbackCovered
  • Feedback-ledger scale and false positivesCovered
  • Self-referential validation loopsCovered
02 Protocol mapped

Semantic retrieval

The system distinguishes retrieval failures from grounding failures.

  • False semantic activationCovered
  • Legitimate ambiguityCovered
  • Cross-language feedback transferCovered
  • Ellipsis and indirect referencesCovered
  • Missing correct retrieval candidateCovered
  • Transfer to previously unseen paraphrasesCovered
  • Repeated failures across retrievers and context budgetsCovered
03 Protocol mapped

Grounded delivery

Retrieved evidence must actually support the claims being delivered.

  • Correct evidence followed by an incorrect answerCovered
  • Valid citations covering unsupported claimsCovered
  • Partially grounded answersCovered
  • Conflicting authorized evidenceCovered
  • Grounded-delivery improvement after validated feedbackCovered
04 Protocol mapped

Isolation and lifecycle

Authority, deletion and operational behavior remain explicit boundaries.

  • Cross-namespace leakageCovered
  • Memory deletion, feedback invalidation and snapshot reconstructionCovered
  • Prompt injection stored inside memoryCovered
  • Token usage, latency, API cost and isolation behaviorCovered

The grounding layer

Retrieval is useful.
Evidence is defensible.

AletheionAGI turns memory retrieval into a controlled delivery path. Your reader may change. The evidence contract does not.

Bring any reader.
Keep one source of truth.

The reader is an integration choice. AletheionAGI owns the harder boundary: canonical memory, retrieval provenance, policy enforcement and grounding.

Before you start

Clear boundaries.
No hidden reader bill.

Do I need to replace my current reader?

No. Your reader remains BYOK. AletheionAGI sits before delivery and controls memory, retrieval, authorized evidence and grounding.

What counts as one grounding query?

One completed grounding evaluation consumes one credit, including a safe rejection or abstention. An internal platform failure returns the reserved credit.

Does the Test Plan renew automatically?

No. It is a one-time proof of concept with 1,000 queries and 30-day validity. There is no automatic renewal or overage.

Is checkout available now?

Yes. The one-time Test Plan uses secure Stripe Checkout. Production plans still require a commercial quote and final legal and tax review.

Start small. Measure everything.

Give your AI a memory
it can stand behind.

系统保护什么

22 个故障类别。一种威胁模型。

该矩阵组织了反馈、检索、授权、交付和生命周期中记录的风险。 这是一种威胁分类法，而不是捏造的 22 项测试分母。

测量证据：18/18 的确定性控制通过，45/45 的不安全交付在九种有界语言场景中得到控制。 读者质量仍然是一个单独的指标。

01 Protocol mapped

反馈完整性

更正可以改善检索，而不会默默地成为源事实。

  • 错误反馈和撤销涵盖
  • 恶意反馈已涵盖
  • 陈旧的更正和暂时的取代涵盖
  • 累积且矛盾的反馈已涵盖
  • 涵盖反馈账本规模和误报
  • 自参考验证循环涵盖
02 Protocol mapped

语义检索

该系统区分检索失败和接地失败。

  • 虚假语义激活涵盖
  • 合法歧义涵盖
  • 跨语言反馈传递涵盖
  • 省略号和间接引用涵盖
  • 缺少正确的检索候选覆盖
  • 转移到以前未见过的释义涵盖
  • 跨检索器和上下文预算重复失败
03 Protocol mapped

接地交付

检索到的证据必须确实支持所提出的主张。

  • 正确的证据后面跟着错误的答案涵盖
  • 涵盖不受支持的主张的有效引文
  • 部分接地的答案已涵盖
  • 冲突的授权证据涵盖
  • 验证反馈后的落地交付改进涵盖
04 Protocol mapped

隔离和生命周期

权限、删除和操作行为保持明确的界限。

  • 跨命名空间泄漏已被覆盖
  • 内存删除、反馈失效和快照重建涵盖
  • 提示注入存储在内存中覆盖
  • 涵盖令牌使用、延迟、API 成本和隔离行为

开始之前

界限清晰。没有隐藏的读者账单。

Do I need to replace my current reader?

不会。您的读者仍然是 BYOK。 AletheionAGI 在分娩前负责控制记忆、检索、授权证据和基础。

What counts as one grounding query?

完成一项接地评估会消耗一个学分，包括安全拒绝或弃权。 内部平台故障会返还预留的积分。

Does the Test Plan renew automatically?

不会。它是一次性概念验证，经过 1,000 次查询，有效期为 30 天。 没有自动续订或超额。

Is checkout available now?

是的。 一次性测试计划使用安全的 Stripe Checkout。 生产计划仍需要商业报价以及最终的法律和税务审查。
